jules: Drafting a compact manager+HR checklist for Ara's start on Monday. Keep Day 1 simple: access, intro, small dev task. Drop comments.

ravi: I'll pick a buddy and block a Day 1 1:1. Plan: starter ticket that touches CI + docs.

jules: Checklist for managers (paste):
Day -1 (before start):
- IT: laptop + SSO + VPN requested
- Slack invite & calendar blocks created
- Repo access request opened (DevEx)
- Manager: prepare starter task + success criteria

Day 1:
- 09:00 welcome (People Ops) + paperwork overview
- 10:00 env setup (DevEx/IT) pair session
- 11:00 team intro round-robin (10m each)
- Lunch with buddy
- 14:00 starter task assigned (small PR)
- 16:30 EOD sync w/ manager (clarify 30/60/90)

Week 1:
- Product + metrics intro (30m)
- Cross-team intros (SRE/Security/Support)
- Merge first green PR or complete starter task
- Set measurable 30/60/90 goals in week-1 1:1

30/60/90 examples (managers should make measurable):
- 30d: run local stack, ship a small change, 2 PRs merged
- 60d: own a ticket stream or small feature, measurable improvement (perf/tests)
- 90d: lead a demo/rollout, document impact + next initiative

Owners: People Ops (paperwork/cal), IT (hardware/accounts), DevEx (env/repos), Manager (mentor/goals), Security (data access).
